title: Bernoulli Flow Models: Self-Consistent Generative Modeling for Binary Data
title_zh: 伯努利流模型：自一致生成建模用于二进制数据

paragraphs.en: Bernoulli Flow Models提出了一种新的生成模型，能够在减少函数评估次数的同时保持样本质量。 Binary diffusion models typically require a large number of function evaluations (NFEs) to generate high-quality samples, making practical inference computationally expensive. Reducing NFEs while preserving sample quality without distillation or additional training remains a significant challenge. Existing binary diffusion models define a discrete one-step forward path and then derive the reverse posterior. In low-NFE settings requiring cross-step sampling, they approximate the true multi-step likelihood with a single-step likelihood transition, which severely degrades sample quality. To address this fundamental limitation and decouple the generative dynamics from fixed discrete time steps, we propose Bernoulli Flow Models (BFM). Rather than relying on sequential one-step Markov diffusion chains, BFM defines a unified continuous global Bernoulli probability flow path between data distributions and pure noise, from which we derive analytical closed-form posterior transitions over arbitrary time intervals. Consequently, reducing the inference NFE is no longer an approximation based on skipping discrete steps; it only requires re-evaluating the analytical posterior over a new time grid. This eliminates the structural training-inference mismatch inherent to discrete chains and yields self-consistent low-NFE sampling. Experiments show that BFM is highly robust to aggressive NFE reduction. On LSUN Churches 256x256, a BFM trained with 256 steps achieves an FID of 9.22 using only 16 sampling steps, whereas the state-of-the-art discrete baseline degrades to 204.10. BFM also remains competitive with continuous and discrete generative baselines under standard full-step inference. These results establish BFM as a theoretically rigorous, self-consistent, and practically effective framework for fast binary data generation.
paragraphs.zh: Bernoulli Flow Models提出了一种新的生成模型，能够在减少函数评估次数的同时保持样本质量。二元扩散模型通常需要大量的函数评估次数（NFEs）来生成高质量样本，这使得实际推理在计算上成本高昂。 在不使用蒸馏或额外训练的情况下，如何在保持样本质量的同时减少NFEs仍然是一个重大挑战。 现有的二元扩散模型定义了一个离散的单步前向路径，然后推导出反向后验分布。 在需要跨步采样的低NFE设置中，它们用单步似然转移来近似真实的多步似然，这会严重降低样本质量。 为了应对这一根本性限制，并将生成动态与固定的离散时间步解耦，我们提出了Bernoulli Flow Models（BFM）。 BFM不依赖顺序的单步马尔可夫扩散链，而是定义了一条统一的全局连续伯努利概率流路径，连接数据分布和纯噪声，并由此推导出任意时间区间上的解析闭式后验转移。 因此，减少推理NFE不再是一种基于跳过离散步骤的近似方法；它只需在新的时间网格上重新评估解析后验分布即可。 这消除了离散链固有的训练与推理之间的结构不匹配，并实现了自洽的低NFE采样。 实验表明，BFM对大幅减少NFE具有很强的鲁棒性。 在LSUN Churches 256x256数据集上，一个经过256步训练的BFM仅需16个采样步骤即可达到9.22的FID值，而最先进的离散基线模型则降至204.10。 在标准的完整步骤推理下，BFM与连续和离散生成基线模型相比仍然具有竞争力。 这些结果确立了BFM作为一个理论严谨、自洽且在实际中高效的快速二元数据生成框架。
